picks.reason: This is a price bet more than a projection bet: the model has Bo Nix at 1.47 TD passes, a hair under the line, but at these odds two or more only has to land a minority of the time. His blended rate is 1.52, trimmed by a game script that takes 3.2% off with DEN expected to score 20.9. The fit's track record at this chance helps: when it said about 44.5% across 169 cases, the over hit 49.7%. The market's no-vig chance is 35.7%; the desk bets 39.1% on over 1.5 against a 37.7% break-even, an edge of 1.4 points, leaning only halfway because this prop type is untested. Against it, only 34% of his weighted games cleared this line, which sits below break-even.
picks.risk: His last 5 games averaged 1.2 TD passes, form the fit does not weigh, and only 34% of his weighted games went over; one passing score and the bet loses.
picks.headline: Bo Nix over 1.5 is a price play, not a projection edge
